name: Sausage, Egg, Beans
notes: Sausage macros are from the label (per 3: 130 kcal, 12g protein, 1g carbs, 8g fat), scaled up to 4. The bean label says 140 kcal for a whole 398ml tin, which looks wrong, so the beans use the earlier figure of 153 kcal for half a tin. Egg and bean macros are estimated from typical values.
